title: A look at proposals for vertical data centers, often the only option where land is limited in places like Taiwan; Kansas City recently rejected a 20-story tower (Tiffany Hsu/New York Times)
summary: Tiffany Hsu / New York Times: A look at proposals for vertical data centers, often the only option where land is limited in places like Taiwan; Kansas City recently rejected a 20-story tower — The facilities that power A.I. and other big data needs are in high demand but widely despised. Some developers are trying to build them up instead of out.
